title: VERITAS Trace
description: Standard export format for a single GraphRAG question-answering run. A system under test emits one Trace per question. VERITAS scores the trace against a golden subgraph and provenance requirements.

veritas_version.description: Version of the VERITAS trace schema this document conforms to.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier of this run (UUID or short hash).

id.description: ID of the benchmark question this trace answers. Must match the dataset.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of the question as asked.

system.description: Identification of the system under test, for reproducibility.

retrieval_mode.description: Free-form label of the retrieval strategy used for THIS run.

graph_snapshot.description: Identifier (hash/date) of the graph version queried. Critical for reproducibility — belief has a half-life.

traversal.description: What the system actually touched in the graph. This is what path fidelity is computed on.

visited_nodes.description: Every node the retrieval step read, in order of first visit.

node_id.description: Stable graph-native ID (elementId, URI, or dataset-defined key).

hop.description: Distance from the entry node(s) at time of first visit.

entry_point.description: True if this node was a retrieval entry point (seed), e.g. from vector search or index lookup.

used_edges.description: Edges the system followed. Edges merely adjacent but not followed must NOT be listed.

retrieval_empty.description: True if retrieval returned no usable graph context. Required for honest-null scoring.

text.description: Final answer shown to the user.

abstained.description: True if the system explicitly declined to answer / reported the graph has no answer. This is the honest-null signal.

abstention_reason.description: If abstained: the system's own statement of what it could not see.
examples: No trace in the dataset addresses GPAI transparency beyond a single data point.

claims.description: Atomic factual claims in the answer, each linked to its supporting evidence. Provenance coverage = share of claims with at least one valid evidence link.

examples: AlN has a band gap of ~4.05 eV (DFT).

evidence.description: Edges and/or nodes supporting this claim. Empty array = unsupported claim.

ref.description: node_id, or 'source|type|target' edge key matching traversal.used_edges.

confidence_stated.description: How the claim's certainty was communicated in the answer text. Used for the overconfidence penalty: a claim resting on a 'derived' or 'weak' edge but stated as 'asserted' is penalized.

timing.description: Optional performance data. Not scored in v0.1, reported for context.

cost.description: Optional. Tokens/calls consumed by the run.

provenance.description: Epistemic grade of an edge. The three-level scale mirrors 'edge brightness = how much to trust it'.

grade.description: measured = primary data (DFT value, statutory text); derived = rule/inference produced from primary data; weak = semantic or heuristic association.

recorded_at.description: When the fact entered the graph. Enables belief half-life analysis in later VERITAS versions.
